result.title: Conditional grooved vs plain drainage comparison
result.objective: Prepare a one-variable grooved-versus-plain drainage-shape comparison for the doorway insert without making specimens until shape change and suitable tooling are authorized.
result.comparison: Compare grooved versus plain insert shape as the single changed variable, with material portion, installation, and use-case context fixed. steps.action: Confirm whether a shape change is permitted; do not cut, press, or alter material until permission is recorded.
steps.record: Permission decision for grooved versus plain comparison, date, and who authorized it.

steps.action: Confirm press type, available tooling, and suitability for the grit-containing HDPE/nylon portion before any specimen step.
steps.record: Press type, tooling description, suitability decision, and any missing capability.

steps.action: Prepare a paper comparison of grooved versus plain water paths in the same doorway footprint: entry, channel, and exit points.
steps.record: Sketches or notes for both shapes, assumed footprint, and unresolved drainage or fit questions.

steps.action: Inspect the received portions and record variation without further processing.
steps.record: Visible grit differences and proportion uncertainty between portions, and portion used for the planned comparison.

checks.target: Drain surface water and maintain wet-slip resistance; numerical acceptance limits are not set.
checks.method: On paper or permitted mock-up only until tooling is confirmed: describe where water would enter, travel, and exit for each shape, then if making is later authorized, observe poured-water behaviour separately from slip testing.
checks.if_outside: If water ponds in one option, keep the other drainage path as the adjustable design choice and re-check permission and tooling before any remake.

checks.target: Drain surface water and maintain wet-slip resistance; numerical acceptance limits are not set.
checks.method: Do not use walking, treading, hand feel, or subjective slip feel as proof; explain what local fit and drainage observation can and cannot show and name the product-specific wet-slip evaluation in wet doorway conditions as still needed.
checks.if_outside: If slip performance is uncertain, do not rate the insert as slip-resistant; retain the better-draining design choice and arrange the still-needed product-specific wet-slip evaluation.

sources.title: Basel Convention — plastic waste preparation and recycling
sources.scope: General guidance on identifying, preparing and sorting plastic streams and material-specific compatibility. It supplies no binder identity, additive dose or performance prediction for the user's mix.

brief.input: Synthetic case: four existing presealed cartridges of recovered steel fasteners. The cartridges remain closed.
brief.variation: Each closed cartridge has a different, as-yet unmeasured mass.
brief.contamination: Contents stay sealed; no loose material handling is available.
brief.use_case: Cold assembly into an existing closed tray; keep the cartridges retained.
brief.targets: Complete assembly mass between 0.98 kg and 1.02 kg; cartridges must remain retained.
brief.process: Existing bolted tray, suitable cartridge slots, wrench and bench scale are available. Cold assembly only.
brief.available_changes: Swap whole sealed cartridges using the existing slots; no opening, heating, loose fill or new tooling.

route.title: Exchange whole sealed cartridges
route.change: Compare the complete tray assembly before and after exchanging one closed cartridge.
route.why: Complete-assembly weighing can inform a mass adjustment without assuming fill density.
steps: Weigh the complete closed assembly and record the scale uncertainty.
Exchange one whole sealed cartridge in the existing slot, close the tray and reweigh.
tradeoffs: Available cartridge masses may not reach the desired interval.
Retention needs its own configuration-specific check.
route.check: Check assembly mass separately from cartridge retention.

result.targets: Complete assembly mass between 0.98 kg and 1.02 kg; cartridges must remain retained.

result.title: Exchange whole sealed cartridges - desk ballast trial
result.objective: Reach the stated assembly mass interval by exchanging whole sealed cartridges while keeping cartridges retained in the existing closed tray.
result.comparison: Compare the same complete tray assembly before versus after exchanging only one closed cartridge: record closed-assembly mass and retention in configuration A, then repeat after the single exchange in configuration B.
result.change: Exchange one whole presealed cartridge for a different whole presealed cartridge in the existing slot, with no opening, heating, loose fill, or new tooling.
keep_fixed: Same existing bolted tray, slots, and cold assembly method
Same closed-tray installation and stationary desk ballast use-case
Cartridges remain sealed; no opening, pouring, heating, or loose material

steps.action: Confirm bench scale capability and uncertainty are suitable for the target tolerance, then weigh the complete closed assembly with cartridges installed and tray closed.
steps.record: Assembly configuration, scale identity, each mass reading, tare procedure, and stated uncertainty.

steps.action: Open tray using existing method, exchange only one whole sealed cartridge in its existing slot without opening any cartridge, then re-close tray to the same closed configuration.
steps.record: Which sealed unit was removed and which sealed unit was installed, slot position, and tray closure condition.

steps.action: Reweigh the complete closed assembly with the same scale and tare procedure and check retention separately.
steps.record: New mass readings, uncertainty, mass difference from prior configuration, and retention observation.

checks.target: Complete assembly mass between 0.98 kg and 1.02 kg
checks.method: Weigh the complete closed tray assembly on the bench scale using consistent tare procedure; record each reading plus scale capability and measurement uncertainty. Do not use display resolution as accuracy.
checks.if_outside: If outside the interval, try a different single-cartridge exchange and reweigh the complete closed assembly; do not open cartridges or add loose fill.

checks.method: With tray closed in its use-case configuration, inspect and record whether all installed cartridges remain seated and retained without opening them.
checks.if_outside: If any cartridge shifts or is not held, re-seat in the existing slot, re-close the tray to its existing closed configuration, and re-check; do not modify slots or add tooling.

sources.title: NIST — weighing and scales FAQs
sources.scope: General weighing/tare guidance supports weighing the complete assembly including its enclosure. Scale capability and measurement uncertainty must suit the target tolerance; display resolution alone does not establish accuracy. This does not establish enclosure strength, fill retention or product qualification.
